metadata.title: On the Existence of Pulsars in the Vicinity of the Massive Black Hole in the Galactic Center

notes: No eligible stars: the paper is a population-synthesis study of simulated Galactic-center pulsars and hypervelocity stars (e.g., T:p1-b4, T:p6-b7) and provides no individual star identifiers or individually retained Galactic-unbound candidates. The Galactic-center magnetar and S-stars mentioned are not Galactic-unbound candidates.
